text:
mira: quick thread — vectors preview export + toolbar accessibility review. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx

devin: CSV header order should match visual: id, text, source, created_at, tags, vec_0..vec_n, norm, rerank

rachel: keyboard focus issues — when tabbing the local toolbar is after the right-side actions. prefer roving tabindex so local toolbar is next.

tom: propose collapsing secondary icons into a "more" kebab to reduce tab stops. kebab must have aria-label: "More actions for <row title>".

aria-bot: scan: missing aria-labels on icon buttons (3), export modal missing aria-live for status, csv ordering mismatch. recommendations: add aria-labels, add aria-live, stabilize headers with vec_ prefix.

mira: next steps: rachel/tom prototype toolbar+kebab, devin update export API and headers, i'll update modal copy and test VoiceOver. ping when PR ready.

devin: will add docs sample for re-import mapping and two export modes: flat csv (vectors columns) and blob csv (base64 vector).
